findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_share_providers" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_share_providers, get_feedback_reply · Private data: resolve_share_link, list_share_providers · Public sink: resolve_share_link, list_share_providers, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_share_providers, get_feedback_reply · Private data: resolve_share_link, list_share_providers · Public sink: resolve_share_link, list_share_providers, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
